target_demo: 20s-40s Korean adults navigating everyday personal finance; mobile-first MZ users who find finance distant or intimidating
narrative_arc: Empathy-to-solution brand story: it opens by calling finance a distant, hard word, then reframes it as something already woven through everyday life via illustrated vignettes (splitting a meal bill with friends, opening a first salary account, moving house, buying a car, planning a nice vacation); at the carefree high point doubt creeps in (am I managing money wisely? unsure and overwhelmed?); the film pivots onto a brand-blue world where sending money became as easy as texting since Toss, demos clean app cards that make all financial life simpler and visible at a glance (한 눈에 보이는 금융), recaps the journey as scrolling icons that bloom into the brand palette, and closes on a phone holding everything in orbit and the centered toss logo — 나에게 금융이 필요한 순간, 토스.
creative_device: everyday-life vignette montage as empathy, doubt-beat as turn, brand-blue world + app-UI proof as resolution, orbit motif bookending the protagonist's financial life

production_signature.signature_note: Entirely flat 2D motion-graphics: locked-off graphic cards (cuts 1,3,10-12,16), simulated continuous dolly/pan and scroll montages (cuts 4,13,14), true orthographic top-down beats (cuts 2,4,15), and full-brand-blue interstitials (cuts 8,9). Metrics mean_abs_shift_x 1.225 with low sign-flip 0.23 reflect lifestyle edit movement and 2D scrolls, NOT 3D wiggle; no handheld shake and no real parallax rig — camera_signature is locked_off with motion-graphics moves.

global_layout.layout_note: Most beats are centered single-focus compositions (coin, walking woman, app cards, logo) with generous margins and lower-third Korean subtitles; the lifestyle and recap beats (cuts 4,13,14) break into scrolling/overhead panoramas, and the transfer beats (cuts 8,9) fill the frame with brand blue.

copywriting.copy_strategy: Disarm finance anxiety by naming it, then prove finance is already part of ordinary life, validate the feeling of being unsure, and resolve with Toss making money simple and visible — closing on a personal brand promise.
